# name=flags, one a line; the first is the base the others are held to.
# Attribution of pinc's gain: CRANK + SCHEDB alone, with PFX, and with PF2PIN.
base=
crank=-DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
pfxc=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
pinc=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
crankst=-DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1 -DPEARL_AMD_STAMP=1
